This section features official assignment problems, step-by-step tutorial guides, and exam preparation packages for ASTB23.

### Assignment Submission Protocol
All solutions must be submitted to Quercus by 12:00 noon on due dates. Submissions must be legibly handwritten or typed with:
1. Sketch of physical scenario
2. Analytical derivations
3. Unit verification
4. Plausibility order-of-magnitude checks
